svg.title: MacBook Pro 16-inch (M5 Pro, PROLED XDR) — space-black
svg.desc: Original front-view vector illustration, MIT (LICENSE.txt). Manufacturer specifications are references for measurements and product details, not sources of artwork. US catalog, 2026-11-20. Reference SKU: MJ2W4LL/A (Silver, standard display). 16.3-inch tandem OLED touchscreen; native 3472 × 2266 px. The circular cutout represents the camera, not the expanded Dynamic Island UI. Apple display reference (1262 × 768 px), front elevation: deck/lid/display widths ≈ 1260/1072/1044 px; lid top y=3, display bottom y≈698, deck starts y≈716, metal ends y≈760, feet end y≈767 (exclusive ends). Native aspect retained; lid meets deck at the visible seam. Four rounded screen corners; centered round camera opening estimated inside the visible pill, not a mask for the software island. Corner radii, lens, recess and underside curves are approximations; feet clearance included without drawing the feet. Finish swatches are illustrative. Sources: https://www.apple.com/macbook-pro/proled-xdr-display/specs/; https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-mac/macbook-pro-proled-xdr; https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/10/apple-unveils-groundbreaking-macbook-pro-with-proled-xdr-display/; https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-pro/proled-xdr-display/b/images/specs/display_16_inch__d25b08sjpqs2_large_2x.jpg; https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-pro/proled-xdr-display/b/images/specs/macbook_pro_proled_16_inch__d1f4ok655iye_large_2x.jpg
